image_description: A dimly lit interior view of a prison cell block, featuring two levels of cells facing each other across a central walkway. The architecture includes metal railings, barred cell doors, and worn concrete or plaster walls with peeling paint. A staircase is visible in the background leading to the upper level. The lighting is low, creating strong shadows and a gritty atmosphere.

artifact_observations.location: Upper left wall and ceiling junction
artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight smudging and lack of clear definition where the wall meets the ceiling arch; texture appears slightly painted-on rather than structurally distinct.
The vertical bars of the railing on the right seem to vary slightly in thickness and alignment, suggesting minor geometric inconsistency in the perspective rendering.
The details in the deep background (stairs and far wall) are excessively soft compared to the foreground, which could be depth-of-field but also resembles AI generation blur.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific architectural style matches known prison/correctional facility interiors versus generic industrial hallways.
To verify the structural integrity of the multi-level walkways and ensure the perspective lines of the railings and walls converge correctly.
To check for fusion artifacts where the thin metal bars meet the walls or floor, a common failure point in AI generation.
To assess the noise pattern and lighting consistency, ensuring the 'gritty' look is natural degradation rather than generative artifacting.

focus_areas: Structural continuity of the metal railings and bars
Perspective consistency of the parallel walkways
Texture realism of the worn walls and peeling paint
Lighting logic in the dim environment
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the intersection points of the railings. AI often fails to render thin, repetitive linear structures like prison bars consistently, causing them to melt into the background or vary in width unnaturally. Also, verify if the 'wear and tear' textures look procedurally generated or physically plausible.
